segments.caption: The video opens with the title card for "TWO WHEEL OKLAHOMA," establishing the show's theme of a motorcycle road trip. The segment then cuts to an indoor event, likely a motorcycle expo, where host Phillip Smage of Smage Bros. Riding Show is introduced. He is seen speaking and smiling alongside another man in front of a backdrop listing tour dates and locations, indicating the show is promoting an upcoming nationwide tour.

At an indoor motocross event, a host interviews Phillip Smage of the Smage Bros. Riding Show, who is revealed to be from Wisconsin. The segment then cuts to the show's main event, where Smage executes a high-flying, backflip-style stunt on his dirt bike, showcasing the thrilling, high-risk nature of the performance.

A motocross rider in a patriotic red, white, and blue jersey performs a dramatic, high-flying stunt on an indoor dirt bike, launching himself and his bike into the air over a large tire obstacle. The scene shifts to show the rider conversing with a man in a green shirt at a convention or exhibition, before returning to the action as he prepares for and executes another powerful jump, showcasing his skill and the thrilling, high-energy nature of the event.

At an indoor motorcycle show, a motocross rider in a red, white, and blue jersey is interviewed by a man in a green shirt, while another rider prepares his bike nearby. The event is set against a backdrop of event schedules and banners, capturing the lively atmosphere of a motorsports exhibition.

At a busy indoor action sports expo in March 2017, a motocross rider in a red, white, and blue jersey and a black cap is seen interacting with fans and the media. He is first shown being interviewed, then gestures enthusiastically while speaking, and later poses with young fans, one of whom is playfully seated on his dirt bike, showcasing his approachable and engaging personality at the event.

At a bustling indoor motocross expo, a young rider in a red, white, and blue racing jersey and cap is interviewed by a man in a green shirt. The scene opens with the rider posing confidently atop his dirt bike alongside friends, before transitioning to a close-up conversation where he gestures and speaks enthusiastically about his experience. The background features event banners advertising races in Florida, reinforcing the setting as a lively motorsports trade show or fan convention.

At a crowded indoor convention, a motocross rider in a colorful jersey and cap is interviewed before mounting his bike, while another rider in a black shirt prepares to perform for an enthusiastic audience gathered behind barriers.

A motocross rider in a red, white, and blue jersey performs a stunt on a dirt bike inside a large indoor arena, drawing the attention of a crowd behind barriers. The scene cuts to an interview with the rider, who gestures animatedly while speaking to an interviewer, set against a backdrop of event signage and vendor tents, indicating the event is part of a larger convention or exhibition.

Inside a large indoor arena, a motocross rider in a colorful red, white, and blue suit performs a high-speed wheelie on a dirt bike, skillfully balancing on the rear wheel as he races past ramps and obstacles, with another rider visible nearby and spectators watching from behind barriers.

The frames depict a motocross stunt rider being interviewed at an indoor expo or trade show. The segment begins with a dynamic shot of the rider performing a wheelie on a dirt bike, showcasing his skill. The scene then cuts to a conversation between the rider, dressed in a colorful racing jersey and cap, and an interviewer in a green shirt. They are standing in front of a "WAGE BROS. RACING SHOWS" tent, with event banners and booths visible
An interviewer in a green shirt speaks with a motocross rider in a colorful jersey at an indoor motorcycle show, before cutting to the rider performing a jump on his dirt bike over a ramp.

A motocross rider in a red, white, and blue jersey performs a high-flying stunt, launching his bike off a ramp at an indoor motorcycle show. The sequence captures the peak of his jump and the subsequent landing, before cutting to an interview where the rider, now in a relaxed setting, discusses his performance with a show attendee.

At a bustling indoor motorcycle show, a man in a lime-green shirt interviews a motocross rider in a red, white, and blue jersey. The rider, gesturing animatedly, speaks enthusiastically to the interviewer, with event schedules and vendor tents visible in the background. The scene then cuts to a different rider performing a wheelie on a dirt bike in a spacious exhibition hall, showcasing the event's dynamic and action-packed atmosphere.

A motorcyclist performs a high-speed wheelie inside a large indoor arena, skillfully balancing on the rear wheel while riding past spectators and event signage for the Progressive International Motorcycle Show.

A motorcyclist performs a daring stunt inside a large indoor arena, riding a custom bike with a massive front wheel while balancing on the rear wheel, then dramatically lifts the bike vertically and turns it into a wheelie, all while a crowd watches from behind barriers.

A motorcycle stunt performer in a colorful racing suit and helmet is seen in a large indoor arena, preparing for or executing a trick on a motorcycle. He is surrounded by spectators and event signage, including a "Trials Show" board and a "Two Wheel Oklahoma" logo. The video ends with a copyright screen for "Two Wheel Oklahoma," indicating it's a promotional clip for a motorcycle event or show.
